scope: Visual redesign of the connected science sections, preserving approved banner, brand breather and shop

references.takeaway: Let microbiological imagery carry the scientific subject, with readable editorial content. No imagery, code or product claims copied.
Reviewed official guidance; same skill already installed locally. No duplicate installation required.

tokens.type: Open Sans for headings and controls; Arial for reading

plan: Continuous green field, larger microbiota illustration on the left and explanatory content on the right, then reversed columns for the gut-brain connection. Tabs update the illustration and the text. Existing product modals connect the educational story to the catalogue.
reviewBeforeBuild: Rejected repeating framed mini-diagrams. Native vector microbiology becomes the focal point; restrained typography and a compact inset product connection support it. Preserve the client's preferred fonts, palette, section order and continuous green.
originalAssets: SVG microbiota illustration with rod-shaped cells, circular microbial forms, labelled leaders and substrate paths; composed organ illustration with two directional communication paths. Conceptual, not laboratory imagery or clinical data.
motion: Substrates travel toward microorganisms; paired signal paths communicate in both directions. Each illustration has an independent pause control. Tab transitions are user initiated; prefers-reduced-motion disables animation.
qa: No horizontal overflow at 320, 390, 820 and 1100 pixels
